lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance circular spots arranged in approximately five horizontal rows and twelve vertical columns posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, forming a lattice where the blobs serve as primary nodal points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper lateral flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with light intensity on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: A complex labyrinthine or vermiculated pattern of high-luminance lines located on the dorsal-anterior section, transitioning into the regular stripe-and-spot grid posteriorly.
